note: Set status to PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED or N/A only after doing the check. On FAIL add severity, actual, evidence, impact and fix. Untouched rows stay NOT_TESTED and earn no points.

records.title: Visual hierarchy: the primary action is the most prominent element on key pages
records.expected: One clear primary action per view

records.title: Typography is consistent (families, scale, line length, line height)
records.expected: A consistent type scale; body text 45-90 characters per line

records.title: Spacing and alignment follow a consistent grid
records.expected: No misaligned or cramped blocks in the screenshots

records.title: Colour use is consistent and matches the brand guidelines if provided
records.expected: Consistent palette; link and button colours used consistently

records.title: Images are sharp, correctly cropped and consistent in ratio
records.expected: No stretched, pixelated or inconsistent product imagery

records.title: Navigation labels are clear and the menu structure matches the catalogue
records.expected: A first-time visitor can find a product category in two clicks

records.title: Product page presents price, variants, stock, shipping and returns clearly
records.expected: All purchase information visible without hunting

records.title: Interactive states exist (hover, focus, active, disabled, loading)
records.expected: Buttons and links give feedback in every state

records.title: Empty and error states are designed (empty cart, no results, 404, form errors)
records.expected: Each state explains what happened and offers a next step

records.title: Copy is free of placeholder text, spelling errors and broken translations
records.expected: No lorem ipsum, default theme text or untranslated strings

records.title: Screenshots reviewed at all six widths for overlap, clipping and broken layouts
records.expected: No visual breakage in evidence/responsive

records.title: Sticky elements (header, add-to-cart bar, chat, cookie banner) do not cover content or controls on phones
records.expected: No control hidden behind a sticky element at 375px

records.title: Checked on at least one physical phone or a second browser engine (Safari/WebKit)
records.expected: Same result as the emulated run

records.title: Every header and footer menu item opens the intended destination
records.expected: No wrong or dead destination

records.title: Contact form submits and shows a confirmation (test submission only, with owner approval)
records.expected: Success message; owner confirms receipt

records.title: Newsletter signup validates input and confirms (test address only, with owner approval)
records.expected: Invalid email rejected; valid email confirmed

records.title: Customer account: register, log in, log out, password reset (test account only)
records.expected: Each flow completes

records.title: Sliders, tabs, accordions, modals and popups open, close and do not trap the user
records.expected: Each component works with mouse and touch

records.title: Product media: gallery, zoom and video work
records.expected: All media load and controls respond

records.title: Language and currency selectors switch and persist
records.expected: Selection applies across pages and in the cart

records.title: Interactive element inventory reviewed: every listed control is tested or explicitly marked untested
records.expected: No unaccounted control on sampled pages

records.title: Search with an empty query is handled
steps: Submit the search form with no text
Submit with spaces only
records.expected: No error page; the search page or a prompt to type a query is shown

records.title: Search with no results shows a helpful state
steps: Search for a nonsense string such as zzqxv
records.expected: A clear no-results message with a way forward (suggestions, popular products or a link to collections)

records.title: Search relevance: known product names, types and a misspelling return the expected products first
steps: Search for 3 exact product titles
Search for a product type
Search for a common misspelling
records.expected: The expected product is in the first results for each query; predictive search agrees with the results page

records.title: Announcement bars: text is current, links work, rotation and dismiss behave, no overlap with the header
records.expected: Every announcement is readable at 320 px and desktop, links open the right page, a dismissed bar stays dismissed

records.title: Dropdown and mega menus open and close by mouse, keyboard and touch
steps: Hover and click each top-level item
Tab, Enter, arrow keys and Escape
Tap on a touch viewport
records.expected: Every submenu opens, every link in it is reachable, the menu closes on Escape and outside click, nothing is cut off at the viewport edge

records.title: External links go to the right destination and open safely
records.expected: Each external link resolves (no 404 or parked domain), points to the store's own profile, and links with target=_blank carry rel=noopener

records.title: A shopper can get from the homepage to a product through the navigation
records.expected: Path works without search

records.title: Collection filters and sorting change the product list correctly
records.expected: Results match the selected filter and sort order

records.title: Variant selection updates price, image, availability and the variant added to the cart
records.expected: The chosen variant is the one in the cart

records.title: Cart quantity update and remove work and totals recalculate
records.expected: Totals are correct after each change

records.title: Cart drawer or cart notification opens, updates and links to cart and checkout
records.expected: Drawer state matches /cart.js

records.title: Discount code field, shipping and tax messaging are present and accurate
records.expected: A test code applies; shipping and tax statements match store settings

records.title: Checkout contact and address step validates and continues
records.expected: Valid data continues; invalid data shows clear errors

records.title: Shipping methods and rates appear for the target regions
records.expected: Expected methods and rates are offered

records.title: Payment completes on a TEST gateway only (Bogus Gateway or Shopify Payments test mode)
records.preconditions: Explicit owner authorisation; test mode confirmed on screen; never a real card
records.expected: Test order is created

records.title: Order confirmation page and confirmation email are correct
records.expected: Correct items, totals and branding; email received

records.title: Cart persists across pages, reload and a return visit
steps: Add an item
Browse 3 other pages
Reload
Close the tab and reopen the store in the same browser
records.expected: Same items and quantities each time; the header cart count agrees with the cart page

records.title: Empty cart state
steps: Open the cart with no items
Remove the last item from a cart
records.expected: A clear empty message with a continue-shopping link; no checkout button, no zero-value totals, no stale count in the header

records.title: Product recommendations load and are relevant
records.expected: Recommended products load without layout shift, link to live products, show correct prices, and exclude the current product and sold-out items where intended

records.title: PDP quantity selector limits: minimum, maximum, invalid input
steps: Use plus and minus
Type 0, a negative number, a decimal, text and a very large number
Add more than the available stock
records.expected: Quantity never goes below 1; invalid input is rejected or corrected; stock limits and quantity rules give a clear message

records.title: Indexing verified in Google Search Console (owner access required)
records.expected: Key pages indexed; no unexpected exclusions

records.title: Structured data validated with the Rich Results Test on one product page
records.expected: Product result eligible, no errors

records.title: Titles and descriptions are unique, accurate and written for the target keywords
records.expected: No duplicated or default boilerplate metadata

records.title: URL redirects exist for removed or renamed pages; internal links avoid redirect chains
records.expected: Old URLs redirect once to the right page

records.title: URL structure: handles are readable, lowercase, hyphenated and free of tracking or session parameters
records.expected: Product, collection, page and article handles describe their content; no duplicate or auto-numbered handles (e.g. "-1", "copy-of-")

records.title: Internal linking: every important page is reachable within three clicks of the homepage and none is orphaned
records.expected: Key collections and products are linked from navigation, collections or content; sitemap URLs with no internal link are listed

records.title: Pagination: paginated collection, blog and search pages are crawlable and canonicalised correctly
records.expected: Page 2+ is reachable through plain links, has a self-referencing canonical (not page 1) and is not blocked by noindex unless intended

records.title: Duplicate content: variant URLs and /collections/x/products/y paths canonicalise to the main product URL
records.expected: Canonical points to /products/<handle>; ?variant= and collection-scoped product URLs do not create indexable duplicates; no duplicated boilerplate copy across products

records.title: Images: served in a modern format at appropriate dimensions with width and height set
records.expected: Shopify CDN serves WebP/AVIF where supported; images are not far larger than their rendered size; srcset is present on content images

records.title: Lighthouse re-run at least twice more; median reported
records.expected: Median of three runs recorded with conditions

records.title: Largest images, third-party scripts and app embeds reviewed in the Lighthouse report
records.expected: Each heavy resource is justified or listed as a defect

records.title: Full keyboard pass: every control reachable and operable, logical order, no trap
records.expected: Complete purchase path possible by keyboard up to checkout

records.title: Screen reader pass (NVDA, VoiceOver or Orca) on the purchase path
records.expected: Names, roles, states and cart updates are announced

records.title: Zoom to 200% and reflow at 320px without loss of content or function
records.expected: No clipped content; no two-direction scrolling

records.title: Alt text is meaningful (not just present); decorative images have empty alt
records.expected: Alt text describes the image purpose

records.title: Form errors are identified in text, linked to the field and announced
records.expected: Errors are not signalled by colour alone

records.title: Modals, drawers and menus manage focus (move in, trap inside, return on close, Escape closes)
records.expected: Focus is never lost behind an overlay

records.title: Motion: autoplay carousels and video can be paused; prefers-reduced-motion respected
records.expected: A pause control exists for content moving longer than 5 seconds

records.title: axe 'incomplete' items (needs review) checked by a person
records.expected: Each incomplete item resolved as pass or defect

records.title: Theme is under version control or a backup copy exists before any change
records.expected: Git history or a duplicated theme is available

records.title: Sections and blocks use valid schema and are editable in the theme editor
records.expected: No broken section in the editor

records.title: Liquid review: no unbounded loops, heavy logic in loops, or deprecated objects and filters
records.expected: No costly or deprecated Liquid patterns

records.title: Assets: no unused or duplicated libraries; scripts deferred; images use responsive image_url sizes
records.expected: Lean asset loading

records.title: Leftover app code from uninstalled apps removed from the theme
records.expected: No orphaned snippets or script tags

records.title: Theme settings and translations complete; no hard-coded strings that should be translatable
records.expected: Locale files cover visible strings

records.title: Installed apps reviewed for overlap, necessity and storefront impact
records.expected: Each app has an owner-confirmed purpose

records.title: Custom code changes are documented and limited to a development theme until approved
records.expected: No unreviewed edit on the published theme

records.title: Staff accounts, collaborator access and two-step authentication reviewed
records.expected: Least privilege; two-step authentication on owner and staff

records.title: App permissions and custom-app API scopes reviewed
records.expected: No unused app with broad scopes

records.title: Third-party script inventory reviewed with the owner
records.expected: Every third-party host has a known purpose

records.title: Legal and trust pages complete and accurate (privacy, refund, shipping, terms, contact details)
records.expected: All policies present and consistent with the checkout

records.title: Cookie consent and customer privacy settings match the target markets
records.expected: Consent collected before non-essential tracking where the law requires it

records.title: Cookie-consent banner interaction: accept, decline and preferences are honoured and remembered
steps: Load the store in a fresh session
Decline, then check cookies and network requests
Reload
Repeat with accept
records.expected: Decline is as easy as accept; no non-essential tracking cookie or request after decline; the choice survives a reload and can be changed later

records.title: No customer data in URLs or browser storage
steps: Browse, search, add to cart and reach checkout
Inspect page URLs and outgoing request URLs for personal data
Inspect localStorage and sessionStorage keys
If a customer account was provided, repeat while signed in
records.expected: No email, name, address, phone or token appears in a URL or query string; localStorage and sessionStorage hold no personal data (key names and data types only are recorded in evidence, never the values)
